title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.6
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.6 is now available.
Added SA-MP Chatlog Viewer & Searcher with category filters, copy, and open folder actions.
Integrated native in-launcher auto-updater with live download progress and silent install.
Added manual Check for Updates button under Settings > About.
Click Update Now below to automatically download and upgrade your launcher.
